# The Chicago Manual of Style

> The authoritative guide to writing, editing, and publishing standards maintained by the University of Chicago Press, offering comprehensive style guidance, citation systems, and editorial resources.

The Chicago Manual of Style Online provides writers, editors, and publishers with essential reference materials across 18 editions, including the Notes and Bibliography and Author-Date citation systems. The site serves as the primary digital resource for Chicago-style writing standards and professional editorial guidance.

## Key Topics

- Chicago-style citations
- Notes and Bibliography system
- Author-Date system
- Editorial standards
- Grammar and usage
- Typography
- Punctuation
- Citation formatting
- Publishing guidelines
- University of Chicago Press
- CMOS Online
- Style guide
- Writing resources
- Editing practices
- Professional writing

## Getting Started

- [The Chicago Manual of Style](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/home.html): Homepage introducing Chicago Manual of Style Online as essential writing reference guide.
- [About The Chicago Manual of Style](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/help-tools/about.html): Overview of Chicago Manual of Style history, purpose, and editorial standards.
- [CMOS Help & Tools](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/help-tools.html): Central hub for help resources, tools, and support for Chicago Manual of Style users.

## Citation & Reference Guides

- [Chicago-Style Citation Quick Guide](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/tools_citationguide.html): Quick reference guide for Chicago-style citations using Notes and Bibliography and Author-Date systems.
- [Contents (18th Edition)](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/book/ed18/frontmatter/toc.html): Table of contents for 18th edition Chicago Manual of Style reference material.
- [Contents (17th Edition)](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/book/ed17/frontmatter/toc.html): Table of contents for 17th edition Chicago Manual of Style reference material.
- [New Questions and Answers](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/qanda/latest.html): Latest Q&A addressing style, typography, and formatting questions from CMOS users.

## Learning & Support

- [Video Tutorials](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/help-tools/Videos.html): Video tutorials for using CMOS Online features and Chicago Manual of Style tools.
- [Subscription Options](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/help-tools/subscription.html): Subscription pricing and options for individual, group, and institutional access.
- [Account Administration Log In](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/accountAdministration): Login portal for Chicago Manual of Style Online account administration and access.

## Optional Resources

- [Site Map](https://www.chicagomanualofstyle.org/sitemap): Site map providing navigation and index of Chicago Manual of Style website content.
